import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os

# Disable unnecessary pandas warnings
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/ru_train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/ru_test_2.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = "./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)


def load_data():
    train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
    test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)
    return train_df, test_df, sample_sub


def build_mapping(df, target_col="before"):
    """Build deterministic frequency-based mapping with tie-breaking rules."""
    df_work = df[target_col].astype(str).copy()
    df_work["after_str"] = df["after"].astype(str)
    df_work["after_len"] = df_work["after_str"].str.len()

    # Count co-occurrences
    counts = df_work.groupby(["before", "after_str"]).size().reset_index(name="freq")

    # Sort by frequency (desc), length (asc), lexicographical order (asc)
    counts = counts.sort_values(
        ["before", "freq", "after_len", "after_str"],
        ascending=[True, False, True, True],
    )

    # Keep the best candidate per input token
    best = counts.drop_duplicates("before", keep="first")[["before", "after_str"]]
    return dict(zip(best["before"], best["after_str"]))


def evaluate_accuracy(predictions, actuals):
    """Compute exact token-level accuracy."""
    preds_arr = np.asarray(predictions, dtype=str)
    actuals_arr = np.asarray(actuals, dtype=str)
    accuracy = np.mean(preds_arr == actuals_arr)
    return accuracy


def main():
    # 1. Load data
    train_df, test_df, sample_sub = load_data()

    # 2. Create 5% hold-out validation split
    np.random.seed(42)
    val_mask = np.random.rand(len(train_df)) < 0.05
    train_only = train_df[~val_mask].reset_index(drop=True)
    val_split = train_df[val_mask].reset_index(drop=True)

    # 3. Build mapping & evaluate on validation set ONLY
    model_map = build_mapping(train_only)

    val_preds = (
        val_split["before"].map(model_map).fillna(val_split["before"]).astype(str)
    )
    val_acc = evaluate_accuracy(val_preds, val_split["after"])
    print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_acc:.4f}")

    # 4. Rebuild mapping on FULL training data for final submission
    full_map = build_mapping(train_df)

    # 5. Generate test predictions
    test_preds = test_df["before"].map(full_map).fillna(test_df["before"]).astype(str)

    # 6. Format and save submission
    test_ids = (
        test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test_df["token_id"].astype(str)
    )
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "after": test_preds})

    submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
    submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
    print(
        f"Submission saved to {submission_path} with {len(submission_df)} predictions."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
